Build passes now (exit 0). What was going on:

- The screen full of warnings (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc.) is just noise from the bundler bump itself — not the problem.
- The actual failure was in the link stage: `ERROR EBUILD02 link-failed`, caused by two real bugs the bump exposed, both from an options-shape change:
  - `src/core/options.js` — `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
  - `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — `isBackoffEnabled` treated an unset flag (`undefined`) as an error, but the new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Added an `undefined` → `false` case.

Build now finishes with `0 errors` (the 8 deprecation warnings remain, but those are expected noise from the dependency bump, not bugs).
